articles.title: Iraola angry as official's board delays subs before goal
articles.summary: Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola says he was angry about being prevented from making a triple substitution sooner during his side's draw against Nottingham Forest.
body: With the game level at 1-1 during the second half at Anfield, the Basque wanted to bring on Ryan Gravenberch, Kostas Tsimikas and Rio Ngumoha.
However, despite the ball going out of play three times, the players were left waiting on the sideline as fourth official Tim Robinson had problems with the board.
To add to Liverpool 's frustrations, the third time the ball went out, instead of play stopping for the changes, Forest took a quick throw-in from which they won a penalty to retake the lead.
Forest wing-back Neco Williams darted in behind the Liverpool backline and was caught by goalkeeper Alisson as he lifted a shot goalwards.

articles.title: Tadej Pogacar pulls out of Vuelta a España after heavy fall on stage eight
articles.summary: Race leader abandons after huge crash on Saturday. Pogacar taken away in ambulance with shoulder injury. Race leader Tadej Pogacar pulled out of the Vuelta a Espana on Saturday after a heavy fall 31km from the finish of a flat stage eight left him with shoulder and face injuries.
body: Pogacar of Team UAE has won five Tour de France titles and a Giro d’Italia and was targeting his first overall victory on the Spanish 21-day race.
Pogacar fell after brushing shoulders with another rider and losing control of his handlebars, falling heavily on his shoulder and face.
With his entire team waiting as the peloton carried on without them, Pogacar tried to remount after a couple of minutes but cried out “no” and winced in pain when he touched his bike.
He was then led to an ambulance as his team-mates set off up the broad and freshly-laid dual carriageway towards the finish line at Xeraco, near Valencia.
points: Race leader abandons after huge crash on Saturday.
Pogacar taken away in ambulance with shoulder injury.

articles.title: Joel Barlow grad TJ Baer named FCBL Defensive Player of the Year
articles.summary: Former Joel Barlow baseball standout TJ Baer earned postseason recognition from the Futures Collegiate Baseball League of New England. The former GametimeCT All-State first team selection was named FCBL Defensive Player of the Year, according to a Thursday morning release.
body: Baer played in 43 games, starting 42 of them. He recorded seven assists and made just two errors in 93 chances between right field, center field and left field. Baer started 20 games in right, 19 in center and three in left. He didn't make an error in his first 21 games with Norwich this summer.

Baer recorded two assists in a 3-1 win over the Nashua Silver Knights on July 24. In the top of the sixth inning, Nashua led, 1-0, and was looking for more when Mike Villani singled to right field. Baer came up firing, however, and threw a strike to catcher Bryce Miller to nail Hudson Story at the plate. Baer threw out a runner trying to go to second base on a fielder's choice in the top of the ninth.
At the plate, Baer batted.318, posted a 4.21 on-base percentage, and stole 19 bases in 20 attempts. The Easton native is heading into his sophomore year at Marist College.

articles.summary: Detroit’s defense intercepted 13 passes last season, tied for 11th in the NFL. Four of those came from cornerbacks, and D.J. Reed accounted for two of them. body: Terrion Arnold, the 24th pick of the 2024 draft, was released by Detroit in June while facing felony charges he has denied, and he agreed to terms with Seattle this month. Reed inherited the No. 1 job, and the group behind him has been shuffled and interrupted by injuries throughout camp.

Tim Twentyman wrote in the club’s own training camp position preview in last month that “the Arnold release hurts Detroit’s depth at the position,” adding it would not surprise him if general manager Brad Holmes added to the spot before the regular season. That went up five weeks before Gonzalez’s name entered the conversation, written by someone the team employs.

Detroit ranked 28th in opponent passer rating in the red zone last season at 104.3, allowing 19 passing touchdowns inside its own 20-yard line without intercepting a throw there. Reed’s year split around a hamstring strain that cost him six games, and he turns 30 in November.
Gonzalez turned 24 this summer and has two seasons left on his contract. He closed 2025 with three pass breakups and four solo tackles in New England’s Super Bowl LX loss to the Seahawks.

articles.title: Swansea cruise to away win at struggling Derby
articles.summary: Swansea remained unbeaten in this season's Championship after goals from Joseph Opoku, Eom Ji-sung and Ronald secured a convincing 3-0 win at Derby.
body: Report and free match highlights from the Sky Bet Championship match between Derby County and Swansea City at Pride Park on Saturday; Joseph Opoku, Ji-Sung Eom and Ronald score in comfortable Swans win.

Opoku netted for the second time following his summer move from Belgian outfit Zulte Waragem, while Eom - the architect of that opener - then got on the scoresheet himself just before half-time with only his second league goal since November. Ronald added a deserved third in second-half stoppage time.
The routine victory meant Vitor Matos' men have collected seven points from a possible nine, while out-of-sorts Derby are still waiting for their first win of the new campaign.

Earlier, Ryan Hedges had the ball in the net for the hosts after just 18 seconds, but that was the nearest John Eustace's men would get to the Swansea goal during a sluggish opening half-hour in which they did not muster a single shot that counted.

We are just days away from the return of NFL football — but first, all 32 teams have some decisions to make.

Over the last few months, each squad has shaken its roster up, entertaining positional battles and welcoming in some fresh faces through free agency and the draft. But the time for roster debates is no longer; the official roster cut-down mark arrives Sunday at 6 p.m. ET.

By that point, every team must have its 90-man offseason roster trimmed down to 53 players for the regular season. Additionally, each club can carry up to 17 practice squad members (with one being an international player), a likely outcome for most of the notable roster cuts.

body: Lando Norris agreed a contract extension in August 2026 to stay at McLaren until at least the end of 2030, with options to extend beyond that season.
Norris has been with McLaren since his F1 debut in 2019 and became world champion in 2025.
Oscar Piastri signed a new multi-year contract extension ahead of the 2025 F1 season that will keep him at McLaren until the end of 2028.
Officially, Mercedes announced George Russell only for 2026 after speculation throughout last summer.
